name: Statistical Ensembles and Phase Space
methods: Define degrees of freedom and construct system Hamiltonian
Count accessible microstates in phase space volume with Planck cell h^(3N)
Select appropriate ensemble: microcanonical (isolated), canonical (thermal bath), grand canonical (open)
Construct probability distribution P_i over eigenstates or phase space cells
problem_types: Classical ideal gas entropy (derivation of Sackur-Tetrode equation)
Two-level system spin paramagnetism in a thermal bath
Fluctuations in energy in the canonical ensemble
pitfalls: Omitting Gibbs factor 1/N! for indistinguishable particles (leading to Gibbs paradox)
Confusing microcanonical fixed-energy constraints with canonical fixed-temperature ensembles
